references.text: Jesus uses the example of David eating the showbread, which was not permitted, to explain that human needs and God's grace take precedence over ritual laws, a point also connected to the warning against the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
In the same chapter, Jesus warns his disciples about the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees, which directly connects to verse 11 where he explains that he was not speaking about bread.
Jesus again warns against the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy, emphasizing the importance of being alert to the false teaching of religious leaders.
